profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary: A software architect, full-stack developer, and engineering team leader. A starter, creator, learner, and mentor with deep experience building mission-critical software systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architecting, designing, and coding store selling and checkout solutions while partnering with some amazing engineers and leaders. This includes:
- Computer vision models for object detection
- ML-based decision models
- Kubernetes services deployed at cloud (GCP) and edge (in store)
- Self-checkout experience enhancements
- Customer returns solutions
- DevOps and observability enhancements
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Kubernetes · JavaScript · Quarkus · Computer Vision · Spring Boot · TypeScript · Java · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Principal Engineering Team Leader
positions.description:
Led payments engineering teams with staff direct reports and contractors
Developed new strategies and designs for our digital and card-present payments
Developed Spring microservices and native app frameworks for our customer-facing mobile and web apps and delivery platforms
Extended our Kubernetes/EKS platform
Developed tools to automate business processes, DevOps, and APM
Provided architecture and technical guidance to development teams
Partnered with business stakeholders, vendors, and industry leaders to develop and implement new payment and fraud mitigation solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Payments · Kubernetes · Spring Boot · Java

positions.title: Principal Solutions Architect
positions.description: Built new distributed, event-driven, cloud-native payment systems.

positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description: Served as enterprise architect and lead developer for new product initiatives, cross-product integration, and technology standards.

positions.title: Senior Engineering Architect
positions.description: Created and integrated high-volume payment systems for ACH, image, and risk analysis.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhanced new payment applications and performance-tuned them to maximize throughput.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed telecommunication provisioning and performance analysis software.

positions.title: Senior Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: Created high-volume payment, remittance, and exception processing systems.
